title: stellaster luteus
intro: Stellaster luteus, commonly known as Indian tobacco, is a plant species native to Asia and India, belonging to the family Solanaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Stellaster luteus are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
